Repo: https://github.com/clawdbot/clawdbot

GitHub issues/comments/PR comments: use literal multiline strings or `-F - <<'EOF'` (or $'...') for real newlines; never embed "\\n".

Source `src/`; tests `*.test.ts`; docs `docs/`; output `dist/`; extensions `extensions/*`. Keep plugin-only deps in extension `package.json`; do not add them to root `package.json` unless core uses them. Installers: `../clawd.bot` (`public/install.sh`, `public/install-cli.sh`, `public/install.ps1`).

Consider **all** built-in + extension channels for shared logic. Core: `docs/channels/`, `src/telegram`, `src/discord`, `src/slack`, `src/signal`, `src/imessage`, `src/web`, `src/channels`, `src/routing`; plugins: `extensions/msteams`, `extensions/matrix`, `extensions/zalo`, `extensions/zalouser`, `extensions/voice-call`.

Mintlify/docs.clawd.bot. Internal `docs/**/*.md` links root-relative, no `.md`/`.mdx`; anchors root-relative. Peter links: full `https://docs.clawd.bot/...`; docs replies end with referenced `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs. README links absolute. Docs must be generic: no personal device names/hostnames/paths; use placeholders like `user@gateway-host` and “gateway host”.

Node **22+**; keep Node + Bun paths working. `pnpm install`; `bun install` (keep `pnpm-lock.yaml` + Bun patching in sync when touching deps/patches). Prefer Bun: `bun <file.ts` / `bunx <tool>`. `pnpm clawdbot ...`, `pnpm dev`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:coverage`, `CLAWDBOT_LIVE_TEST=1 pnpm test:live`, `LIVE=1 pnpm test:live`, `pnpm test:docker:live-models`, `pnpm test:docker:live-gateway`, `pnpm test:docker:onboard`; full kit `docs/testing.md`.

TypeScript ESM; strict typing; avoid `any`. Run `pnpm lint` before commits and `pnpm test` (or `pnpm test:coverage`) before pushing logic changes. Keep files concis
